Subject: FinTechCo - Deployment mode qualification (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - follow-up

Hi Alex / Priya -

Great to meet earlier today - thanks for the time. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can validate the right deployment mode for FinTechCo (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

Summary of your stated constraints:
- SSO: SAML 2.0 + SCIM provisioning for user sync; must integrate with Okta (customer-managed IdP).
- KMS/HSM: Keys must be customer-managed; we need to confirm support for Cloud KMS + external HSM (FIPS/PCI requirements).
- Logging retention: Audit/logging retention requirement is 7-10 years for transaction metadata; logs must be exportable to your SIEM (Splunk) and support encryption at rest.
- Data residency & isolation: Preference for dedicated capacity or private VPC due to regulatory controls; Hosted API acceptable only if we can meet KMS and log retention guarantees.

Attachments I shared after the call: redwood-kms-integration.pdf (high-level KMS/HSM options) and sso-implementation-guide.pdf.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive with our security/SE team to validate KMS/HSM and log retention end-to-end (30-45m).
2) Provide SOC2 and architecture artifacts (we can share SOC2-report-2026.pdf + network diagrams)
3) If KMS/HSM + log retention cannot be met on Hosted, we'll scope Dedicated vs Private: Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) typically meets isolation/throughput needs but Private VPC gives you full control over key management and log retention policy.

Can you share a couple of preferred time slots this week for the technical deep-dive? I'll include Rishi (SE) and Monica (security) from our side.

Thanks -
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-kms-integration.pdf; sso-implementation-guide.pdf

Subject: Re: FinTechCo - Deployment mode qualification (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - follow-up

Thanks Marissa - good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) KMS/HSM: Our legal/compliance team requires customer-managed keys for any production model that sees transaction identifiers. We currently use AWS KMS + CloudHSM for the highest-sensitivity keys. If Redwood can support BYOK with CloudHSM-backed keys (or HSM integration via a supported KMS flow), Hosted might work.

2) Logging retention: We need 10 years of immutable audit logs for certain transaction flows. Can Redwood push logs to our Splunk (forwarder) and guarantee retention even if the account is terminated?

3) SSO/SCIM: Okta is our IdP. SCIM provisioning needs to be supported (we have an org-wide SCIM integration).

If Hosted can meet (1) and (2) with a clear terms addendum, we'd prefer that since time-to-market is faster. If not, we'll evaluate Dedicated vs Private. 

Available for the deep-dive: Tue 16 Feb 10-11am PST or Wed 17 Feb 2-4pm PST.

Alex
Head of Platform Ops | FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTechCo - Deployment mode qualification (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - follow-up

Hey Alex - thanks for the details, that helps. Short answers up front, then proposed scoping items for the deep-dive: 

KMS/HSM:
- Redwood Hosted supports BYOK using customer-managed KMS keys in AWS (KMS CMKs). For HSM-level requirements, we support integrating with CloudHSM via an approved flow - we can either: (a) accept envelope keys where AWS KMS is backed by CloudHSM under your account (recommended), or (b) for Private deployments, you can attach an HSM in your VPC and we will route crypto operations accordingly.
- We need to validate the exact key policies and HKDF flows with your security team.

Logging retention / export:
- We can forward audit and platform logs to your Splunk instance (forwarder or S3 ingestion). Retention guarantees: on Hosted we retain logs per our standard retention (90-365 days depending on plan) but we can support pushing immutable copies to your S3 with lifecycle policies you control - that meets the immutability requirement. For contractual guarantees around retention post-termination, that typically maps to Private deployments or Dedicated with a contract addendum (we can scope that).

SSO / SCIM:
- Full SAML 2.0 + SCIM provisioning supported across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. SCIM is enabled per-tenant and can be pointed at your Okta config.

Deep-dive agenda (30-45m):
- KMS/HSM integration options + required network/NAT/VPC config
- Logging delivery, schema, and retention SLAs (Splunk forwarder + S3 export)
- Data flow diagram for token/transaction identifiers (redaction, masking options)
- Timeline and gating for Private deployment (if needed)

I can do Tue 16 Feb 10:30-11:00am PST (fits within Alex's window) - propose we block 45m to leave room for follow-ups. I'll prepare a short tech brief and bring Monica (security) and an infra engineer.

Regards,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
